description: This file defines a declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes PodAffinityTerm, including methods for building and chaining configuration options.

classes.name: PodAffinityTermApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes PodAffinityTerm, with fields for label selectors, namespaces, topology key, and label key considerations.

methods.name: PodAffinityTerm

methods.description: Sets the TopologyKey field in the configuration, supporting chaining.
